title: 8 NV2A alpha-test (func, ref) combinations
purpose: Render an 8-cell 4x2 grid isolating the NV2A alpha-test ROP gate (NV097_SET_ALPHA_TEST_ENABLE 0x0300 + NV097_SET_ALPHA_FUNC 0x033C + NV097_SET_ALPHA_REF 0x0340). Per cell: an alpha-test-OFF BLUE background quad is drawn, then an alpha-test-ON RED quad (per-cell alpha A) with the cell's (func, ref=0x80). RED survives only if the alpha test passes; otherwise it is discarded and BLUE shows through. Captured cell = RED (pass) or BLUE (discard); both saturated 0/255 endpoints so byte-exact across renderers. Funcs use the raw 0-indexed PshAlphaFunc enum (NEVER=0,LESS=1,EQUAL=2,LEQUAL=3,GREATER=4,NOTEQUAL=5,GEQUAL=6,ALWAYS=7), verified against hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/psh_regs.h:162 and the no-remap path in pgraph.c SET_ALPHA_FUNC. Cells: (0) NEVER A=0xFF discard; (1) ALWAYS A=0x00 pass; (2) LESS A=0x40 pass; (3) LESS A=0xC0 discard; (4) GEQUAL A=0x80 pass; (5) GREATER A=0x80 discard; (6) EQUAL A=0x80 pass; (7) NOTEQUAL A=0x80 discard. Cells 4-7 are A==ref boundary discriminators for >= vs > and == vs != off-by-ones and the 0-indexed func decode. Blend/depth/stencil OFF so alpha test is the only variable; foreground RGB opaque, only its ALPHA drives the test. LEQUAL and non-128 ref sweeps + mid-range fractional alpha are second-wave follow-ups.
